subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Despondent
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Hopeful.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Despondent **means **feeling extremely unhappy and without hope** (अत्यधिक दुखी और आशाहीन महसूस करना).

 
 
• For example, "After failing his exam, he became **despondent **and didn't want to leave his room."
 
 
 
• The correct answer is **option 4, Hopeful, **which means** feeling optimistic and confident about the future.**
 
 
• For example, "Despite the setbacks, she remained **hopeful **that things would improve."
 
 
 
• It is the correct antonym because it is the opposite of feeling despondent, which is to feel hopeless and pessimistic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, Precise**, means exact and accurate (एकदम सही).

 
 
• For example, "The surgeon had to be very **precise **during the operation."
 
 
 
• **Option 2, Despaired,** means to have lost all hope (सारी आशा खो देना).
 
 
• For example, "She **despaired **when she realized she had lost her wallet."
 
 
 
• **Option 3, Reproach,** means to express disapproval or disappointment (अस्वीकृति या निराशा व्यक्त करना).
 
 
• For example, "The teacher **reproached **the student for not completing their homework."
 
 

46:T5c2,

Here the correct answer is **Option 3.**
